behavior_constraints: Single Go binary serving an HTTP gateway on default port 9090
All state persists to disk as JSON files under /app/data/ and survives restarts

Config loaded from /app/data/config.json at startup with defaults for port, data_dir, model_storage_dir, inference_timeout_sec=30, max_batch_size=100, webhook_timeout_sec=5, metrics_retention_hours=24, max_model_size_mb=500
Models are versioned with semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; each version has independent deployment status (undeployed default, deploying, deployed, failed)
Model framework must be one of tensorflow, pytorch, onnx, custom
Only one version per model may be deployed; deploying a new version auto-undeploys the current
DELETE model returns 409 if any version is deployed
Model version upload is multipart with version, binary file, and optional release_notes; binary stored on disk
Inference executes only deployed model binaries: binary reads JSON from stdin and writes JSON to stdout
Single inference returns {model, version, latency_ms, timestamp (ISO8601), result}
entities.summary: Build from scratch a complete Go-binary ML model serving platform: model registry with versioned artifacts, inference engine executing model binaries, API-key RBAC auth, metrics, audit logging, webhooks, JSON-on-disk persistence, and graceful lifecycle on port 9090.

instruction_head:
Build a complete ML model serving platform as a single Go binary. The platform is an HTTP gateway (default port 9090) that manages model artifacts, serves real-time and batch inference requests, and provides authentication with role-based access, metrics collection, audit logging, and webhook notifications. All state persists to disk as JSON files under `/app/data/` and survives restarts.
